content:
#2 Just happened across this while I was searching for something else. In general, I don’t think there’s often any reason things AREN’T written up on the nlab, other than nobody has gotten around to it. As far as I can tell, people write things up on the nlab when they’re thinking about them, rather than in some systematic way meant to cover all the bases.

However, Feynman categories do look interesting, so thanks for posting this!
subject: Feynman categories
